messages:
claire: quick sync - the unified prefix-kv path we rolled out exposed a short stale-read window during cross-node handoffs. streaming cursors can see demoted data for ~150-450ms. not data loss but violates correctness guarantees for some customers.

dom: can you paste the smallest repro trace?

claire: yep, simplified:
PUT prefix Y -> node A (epoch 501)
EVICT prefix Y -> tombstone, epoch 502
Handoff -> node B assumes ownership but some read paths still consult cache marked by A until epoch broadcast arrives (~200-400ms)
Cursor read -> returns demoted entries

anya: sounds like we cut the synchronous lease-refresh to reduce RPCs. that saved cycles but introduced the race.

dom: options: 1) keep async (best perf) 2) reintroduce forced lease-refresh on handoff (+~1ms p99) 3) best-effort invalidation message with retries 4) opt-in strict handoff per deployment class.

claire: my preference: opt-in strict mode plus telemetry. add metric prefetch.handoff_stale_reads and a tracing span pairing handoff->read. default OFF for Hosted to preserve perf, default ON for Dedicated/Private.

anya: agree. i'll add chaos tests (kill owner mid-handoff) and a unit test for lease-epoch fence. dom: can you measure p99 delta on handoff-heavy traces?

dom: will run microbench today. initial run shows ~0.7-0.9ms p99 delta when forcing the lease-refresh.

claire: plan: land feature flag kv.unified.strict_handoff, wire metrics + traces, run 72h canary with flag ON for subset traffic and attach repro job. opsbot: create ticket.

opsbot: Ticket RDW-ENG-11077 created: "canary: unified-kv strict_handoff deploy + repro". Assignees: claire, anya, dom. Canary window: 72h. Link: https://tickets.internal/11077 :white_check_mark:

claire: i'll post canary results and perf numbers here. thanks all.
